scan_contract.scope_manifest_algorithm: SHA-256 over ordinal-sorted repository-relative UTF-8 paths joined by LF
scan_contract.finding_handling: fail with path, detector ID and redacted location only; never print matched content

records.rule: Patient identity, OPD alias, NOK/contact, address, occupation, insurance, provider/company, remediation, target comparison and quarantine facts are protected data.

Repository artifacts contain no Classic, target-derived or plausibly real names, OPD values, phone numbers, addresses, contact values, member/policy/CCC values, raw source keys, raw target IDs, row-level dates, row tokens, remediation values or eligibility facts. The only value-bearing exception is the rigidly namespaced, independently invented Cohort A synthetic contract file governed by PILOT-PRIV-006 and the versioned scanner allow-list.
Repository-safe evidence is limited to aggregate counts, stable contract IDs, approved nonidentifying allow-list values and nonsecret specification/query/result hashes.

Runtime tokens use domain-separated HMAC-SHA-256, environment-protected secret material, pinned key and canonicalization versions and typed length-prefixed UTF-8 inputs with explicit null/type markers.
Plain hashes of low-entropy identity/contact/member values and comparison across domain, environment, key or canonicalization versions are prohibited.

Synthetic fixture values are permitted only inside patient_pilot_scenarios.json, must carry fixture_namespace SYNTHETIC-ONLY-P2F and per-record synthetic markers, must be obviously fictitious and independently generated, and must never be copied or lightly modified from Classic or target data.
Artifact scanning covers every file under docs/legacy-migration and Phase 2F focused tests, not only new artifacts.
Scan diagnostics print only path, detector ID and redacted line/field location; matched sensitive content is never printed.
A suspected leak stops the run, triggers containment and purge, rotates affected secrets/keys where necessary, and requires a complete artifact rescan before release.
